items.title: 67848_Jimmy McPartland oral history interview
items.q: Bernie Foyer wanted him to become a Rudy Valee you know and be a real bandleader style.

ctx.x: Ben Pollack fired me. See this Bernie Foyer wanted him to become a Rudy Valee you know and be a real bandleader style. Whereas he had been one of the guys before you know. Oh, he was a good drummer and everything. So Benny Goodman, I mean Benny Pollack fired me. He says, dirty shoes and

started hollering after the show. So he says, you've got two weeks' notice Jimmy, you know, I'm firing you. So Benny Goodman said, what did you say Ben Pollack? What? He says, I gave Jimmy his notice. He's got two weeks' notice. And Benny Goodman said, if you fire Jimmy you got my notice too. He says, I quit. Benny Goodman did.
